stories.headline: Anthropic Launches "Ode With Anthropic," a $1.5B Enterprise Joint Venture With Blackstone and Hellman & Friedman
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman launched Ode with Anthropic, a $1.5B, 100-engineer joint venture betting the next trillion-dollar layer of AI is enterprise implementation inside regulated mid-market banks, health systems, and manufacturers.

pull_quote.text: It's pretty easy to imagine this as a trillion-dollar company someday if we execute well.
pull_quote.role: CEO and Co-Founder, Ode with Anthropic

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic makes its biggest bet yet that the money in AI lies not only in building frontier models, but in deploying them.

stories.headline: Baseten Raises $1.5B Series F at a $13B Valuation as Inference Becomes AI's Most Contested Layer
stories.key_takeaway: Baseten's $1.5B Series F at a $13B valuation, its fourth raise in 18 months, signals AI's economic center of gravity is shifting from training to inference, the recurring cost of serving models in production.

pull_quote.text: The future of AI will be built on millions of specialized models, and the companies building the best ones know that post-training has become existential.

stories.article_excerpt: Baseten's $1.5B Series F values the inference startup at $13B, its fourth raise in 18 months, as serving models becomes AI's hottest layer.

stories.headline: Prometheus Raises $12B Series B at a $41B Valuation for Industrial and Physical AI
stories.key_takeaway: Jeff Bezos's physical-AI startup Prometheus raised $12B at a $41B valuation to build an artificial general engineer, signaling institutional capital's move into industrial AI.

pull_quote.text: The pace of our physical creation right now is nowhere near the pace of human imagination.

stories.article_excerpt: Jeff Bezos's secretive industrial-AI venture Prometheus raised $12B at a $41B valuation, one of 2026's largest rounds.

stories.headline: Taktile Raises $110M Led by Goldman Sachs to Scale AI-Driven Decisioning for Banks and Fintechs
stories.key_takeaway: Taktile's $110M Goldman-led Series C signals AI decisioning is moving from the edges of finance to the regulated core of credit, fraud, and claims decisions.

pull_quote.text: General purpose AI tooling is fine for simple automations, but it isn't sufficient for operating mission-critical financial decisions where errors can cost millions.

stories.article_excerpt: Taktile raised $110M in a Goldman Sachs-led Series C to scale its agentic decisioning platform for banks and insurers.

stories.headline: OpenAI's Public IPO Filing Nears as Its S-1 Is Expected Mid-August
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI's public S-1 is expected on SEC EDGAR in mid-to-late August 2026, teeing up one of the largest tech IPOs ever at a targeted $1 trillion-plus valuation despite steep losses.

pull_quote.text: OpenAI executives have reportedly called any valuation below $1 trillion a nonstarter for the offering.

stories.article_excerpt: After a confidential June filing, OpenAI's S-1 prospectus is expected public in mid-August, opening its finances to scrutiny.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Open-Sources NOOA, a Radically Simple Agent Framework Scoring 82% on SWE-bench
stories.key_takeaway: NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 NOOA reframes an agent as a single Python class where ellipsis-bodied methods are completed by an LLM at runtime, hitting 82.2% on SWE-bench Verified at roughly half the tokens of rival harnesses.

pull_quote.text: An agent is a single Python class: its methods are its capabilities, its fields are its state, its docstrings are its prompts, and its type annotations are enforced contracts.

stories.article_excerpt: NVIDIA Labs open-sourced NOOA, a framework built on one defiant idea: an AI agent is just a Python class.

stories.headline: Sail Research Raises $80M to Build Infrastructure for Long-Horizon AI Agents
stories.key_takeaway: Sail Research raised $80M in seed and Series A at a $450M valuation to build a purpose-built inference and sandbox stack for AI agents that run for hours or days.

pull_quote.text: Sail exists to make intelligence abundant. Every decision we make, from the chip level to the API, is about giving teams the tokens, the scale, and the runtime to build agents without limits.

stories.article_excerpt: Sail Research raised $80M at a $450M valuation to build inference and sandbox infrastructure for agents that run for hours or days.

stories.headline: 'Learning When to Plan' Teaches AI Agents to Budget Their Own Thinking Time
stories.key_takeaway: Teaching an 8B LLM agent to decide when to plan rather than reasoning at every step lets it match a 70B baseline's reward while generating about 85% fewer tokens.

pull_quote.text: Always planning is computationally expensive and degrades performance on long-horizon tasks, while never planning further limits performance.

stories.article_excerpt: A UCL-led team shows AI agents that learn WHEN to plan match a 70B model's performance while using 85% fewer tokens.

stories.headline: COMPASS Uses Evolving Context to Push AI Agents Through Long-Horizon Tasks
stories.key_takeaway: COMPASS splits an agent into a Main Agent, Meta-Thinker, and Context Manager that maintains a distilled evolving context, lifting long-horizon accuracy up to 20% over baselines on GAIA, BrowseComp, and HLE.

pull_quote.text: We identify context management as the central bottleneck: extended histories cause agents to overlook critical evidence or become distracted by irrelevant information.
pull_quote.role: COMPASS authors, University of Virginia and Google

stories.article_excerpt: COMPASS splits agents into a Main Agent, Meta-Thinker, and Context Manager that distills an evolving brief, lifting long-horizon accuracy.

stories.headline: 'WebUncertainty' Gives Autonomous Web Agents a Sense of Their Own Doubt
stories.key_takeaway: WebUncertainty gives web agents a two-level sense of their own doubt, using task-level adaptive planning and action-level uncertainty inside MCTS to cut confident failures and set new state-of-the-art on WebArena and WebVoyager.

pull_quote.text: We introduce an Action Uncertainty-Driven MCTS Reasoning Mechanism, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty to guide the search, mitigating hallucinations and ensuring reliable decision-making.
pull_quote.role: WebUncertainty authors, Hefei University of Technology

stories.article_excerpt: A dual-level uncertainty framework teaches autonomous web agents to notice when they are unsure at both planning and action levels.

stories.headline: Anthropic Names Former California Justice Tino Cuellar as Its First Chief Global Affairs Officer
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic elevated government affairs to a top executive function by hiring former California Supreme Court Justice and ex-Carnegie Endowment president Tino Cuellar as its first Chief Global Affairs Officer.

pull_quote.text: Democratic societies need to shape how this technology develops, rather than letting it simply happen to them.

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic appoints former California Supreme Court Justice Tino Cuellar as its first Chief Global Affairs Officer amid regulatory fights.

stories.headline: China Issues Its First Fines Under New Companion-AI Rules as the Enforcement Era Begins
stories.key_takeaway: Weeks after its companion-AI rules took effect on July 15, 2026, China issued its first fines for noncompliance, turning a written regime into live enforcement just as the EU switched on its own GPAI penalty powers.

pull_quote.text: Before deployment, each agent's decisions must be sorted into three levels of authority: human-only, user-approval-required, and agent-autonomous.
pull_quote.role: China national AI framework, effective July 15, 2026

stories.article_excerpt: Weeks after its landmark AI companion rules took effect, China issued its first noncompliance fines, opening a global enforcement era.
